note: The session's shared web-search allowance was already used up when this part began (200 of 200), so no candidate could be searched for by name. Only government pages reachable by their known addresses were read: Lexington's page about its mayor, Paducah's Board of Commissioners pages and the Jefferson District Court's list of judges. No campaign website was confirmed for anyone in this part; guessed addresses for Linda Gorton's campaign did not resolve, and none was recorded. Josh Bray (a sitting legislator) is already listed on the Republican Party of Kentucky's candidates page, which is in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json as a listing, not an endorsement, so nothing is added for him here. The county, constable, magistrate, school board and other city candidates in this part were not found on any page that could be read without a search and are left blank. The Jefferson District Court's page lists Megan McDonald among its sixteen judges but gives no division numbers (the 01 to 16 beside each name is only its place in the page's list), so her present division is not recorded. Verifier (2026-10-03): all three pages re-opened; every finding stated as recorded; each person tied to the race by state, place and the office held; names match our list exactly.
